name: Business Confidence Score
tagline: A single number that tells you how protected your business really is.
description: The Business Confidence Score is Jojan One's proprietary measure of your business's overall protection health. It aggregates data across seven pillars: compliance, risk, governance, people, data, contracts and finance, and translates them into a single, actionable score from 0 to 100. Know where you stand. Know what to fix.

features.title: Seven-pillar assessment
features.description: Your score is built from seven distinct business protection pillars: compliance, risk, governance, people, data, contracts and finance. Each pillar is assessed independently and contributes to your overall score.

features.title: Real-time scoring
features.description: Your score updates automatically as you complete actions, generate documents, resolve risks and meet compliance obligations – so it always reflects your current protection status.

features.title: Pillar-level breakdown
features.description: Drill into any of the seven pillars to see exactly which factors are driving your score up or holding it back, with clear guidance on what to prioritise.

features.title: Score history and trends
features.description: Track how your Business Confidence Score has changed over time. See the impact of the actions you've taken and demonstrate continuous improvement to stakeholders.

features.title: Benchmarking
features.description: Understand how your score compares to businesses of a similar size and sector, so you can set realistic targets and identify where you're ahead or behind.

features.title: Recommended actions
features.description: Jova surfaces the highest-impact actions you can take right now to improve your score, ranked by effort and potential uplift so you always know where to focus.

benefits.text: Instant clarity on your business's overall protection health
Prioritise the actions that move the needle most
Demonstrate business readiness to investors, lenders and partners
Track improvement over time with a clear, auditable record
